title: El Segundo +25-mile public manufacturing capabilities atlas
scope: 23 organizations, public commercial capabilities and ecosystem context. Curated directory, not an exhaustive census or supplier approval.
distance_origin: El Segundo City Hall, 350 Main Street, El Segundo, CA 90245
distance_warning: Distances are coarse, unverified straight-line estimates, not routing or geocoded measurements. All entries are believed within 25 miles; exact boundary inclusion remains to be checked by public-address geocoding. Coordinates intentionally null.
outside_work_definition: yes = a public external customer product/service pathway exists in the stated scope; no = manufacture is explicitly outside the mission; unknown = not established. None means the organization agreed to this project.
verification_warning: Web-source check on stated date establishes advertised capability, not operational audit, current capacity, certificate validity, commercial acceptance or partnership.
